verdict.seen: Orange engine on a wooden base; the chain and bar are absent in the first frame, then a sprocket and chain bar sit on the engine shaft in the later frames.
Engine block with the chain sprocket and bar on the shaft, clearly visible with a NEVER STOPS caption. Spinning can't be judged from one frame but the setup is right.
A loose drum cup appears around the sprocket and the shaft is visible inside it. The chain looks stationary across frames while the shaft stays exposed.
Three red shoes grow from small to large on the shaft and sit against the drum rim. The change is visible across frames.
A gold ring spring appears around the hub, and the shoes move inward toward the hub across the frames.
A glowing yellow square outline surrounds the clutch (drum, shoes and shaft), which is clearly in view.
The clutch is highlighted at first, then yellow arrows show the shoes flinging outward against the drum while the chain sits on the bar.
The bar tips up from horizontal to a steep angle with a KICKBACK caption, and yellow arrows show the clutch still engaged.
The bar drops back down, a yellow hand guard tips forward and a red brake band appears around the drum.
The rpm gauge and OVERHEATING caption cover the clutch. The shoes are hidden behind the big gauge and no red glow is visible on them.
verdict.problem: The gauge panels hide the clutch, so the shoes can't be seen glowing red. Move the gauges aside or zoom the camera on the shoes and drum.

verdict.seen: The rpm gauge falls from 13,000 red to 2,700 green, but the gauge panels cover the clutch and the trigger. The shoes pulling back and cooling can't be seen.
verdict.problem: The trigger is not visible, and the shoes are hidden behind the gauge. Show the trigger being squeezed and released and move the gauge off the clutch.

verdict.seen: The camera pulls back, but the gauge panel and rpm bar still cover part of the saw, and a stray black pole sits at the right edge in the last frame.
verdict.problem: The gauges cover the engine and clutch, so the whole build is not clearly visible. Remove or move the gauges and clear the stray pole.
